title.narrative: CTF Carbon Fund NACA (Norwegian Article 6 Climate Action) Fund

description.narrative: DAPA Program (GIS03) is scheduled to be terminated as of Q1 2025 and its activities will continue as part of the NACA (Norwegian Article 6 Climate Action) Fund. The NACA Fund was established through the Decision Memo 5908. Remaining fund under the DAPA Program will be transferred to this newly established NACA Fund. In addition to the DAPA Termination Agreement (expected to be signed early 2025), a separate agreement with NMCE will be signed in the form of an Amended Contribution Agreement No.1 to the NACA Fund to move the funding balance into the Fund. This amendment to NACA Fund is expected to be signed in Q2 2025.New project codes will be activated as soon as these agreements are signed and the transition date is determined.T2403CP-T1 for Fund ExpensesCTFT002-E1, E2, etc. for budgeting and reporting of continued technical assistance activities under the NACA Fund.
